To sync your sleep data, please grant access to Health Connect. We will read your sleep sessions, heart rate, and HRV data.
Automatically sync sleep data every 15 minutes

Some Samsung Galaxy Watch models (especially Galaxy Watch 7/Ultra with One UI 8) may report inaccurate sleep stage detection. If you notice significant discrepancies between your actual sleep and recorded data, consider using the subjective sleep diary as your primary data source.
This will disconnect your device from SleepCore. You will need to link again to sync sleep data.

SleepCore Companion App Privacy Policy

 We collect sleep data from Health Connect to provide personalized sleep therapy recommendations.

 Data collected:
 • Sleep sessions (duration, stages)
 • Heart Rate Variability (HRV)
 • Heart Rate during sleep
 • Resting Heart Rate

 Your data is:
 • Encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3)
 • Stored securely on our servers
 • Never shared with third parties
 • Used only for your sleep therapy

 You can delete your data at any time by unlinking the device.
